items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: Well, Pequil was a different man. Pequil would play music very suddenly. Yeah, you see, Pequil is a tinsmith... But he was such a nice man... Pequil was a whole lot jealous of his wife.

ctx.x: You were going to say something about Pequil. Was Pequil like that?

Well, Pequil was a different man. Pequil would play music very suddenly. Yeah, you see, Pequil is a tinsmith. He's supposed to be a tinsmith, you understand? And he was laying on with the handle or something. But he was very independent. If he'd come out, it was all right. If he didn't, it was all right. Now, how he'd come out would have spread.
